passive_sentences: Photosynthesis is utilised by plants in order to facilitate the conversion of sunlight into chemical energy.
The glucose is then transported - via the phloem - to additional parts of the plant, where it is stored.
Farmers who take a laissez-faire approach to watering may find that their crops are DAMAGED by drought.
